statement_made: I think we’re [bleeping] starving.
event_description: Describing the Chargers' level of motivation after signing a multi-year contract extension and reflecting on falling short in the previous postseasons.

statement_made: I know I play with a chip on my shoulder, always got something to prove, always want to find ways to get better each and every season.
event_description: Reflecting on his mindset after securing a new long-term deal with the Chargers in the 2026 offseason.

statement_made: I'm more of a run stopper, push the pocket. I do good with anchoring and taking on double teams and creating knockbacks.
event_description: Describing his playstyle and what he brings to the trenches after being drafted 145th overall by the Chargers.

statement_made: Ready to get to work in the Pacific Northwest. Seattle, let’s go!
event_description: Commenting on his third-round selection by the Seahawks in the 2026 NFL Draft.

statement_made: New Orleans is a place where I can really showcase what I do. I’m ready to contribute to this offense alongside Chris (Olave).
event_description: Discussing his fit with the Saints after being selected as a top-10 pick despite an injury-hampered final college season.

statement_made: I’m focused on the future and being the best player I can be for Tampa Bay. I’m ready to get after the quarterback.
event_description: Addressing the media after being the surprise first-round selection for the Buccaneers at No. 15.

statement_made: Bain brings an edge and a passion that is contagious. He’s exactly the kind of disruptor we want on our front.
event_description: Bucs head coach praising the pick of Rueben Bain Jr. during the team's post-draft wrap-up.

statement_made: I don't look at the 'RB value' talk. I look at what I can do for the Cardinals on the field. I'm here to score points.
event_description: Responding to being drafted 3rd overall, a high slot for a running back in the modern NFL.

statement_made: Arizona is getting a nasty blocker. I'm ready to protect my QB and open lanes for Jeremiyah.
event_description: Post-draft comments from the Cardinals' second-round pick regarding his physical playstyle.

statement_made: Just wanted an opportunity to show what I can do at this level. Thankful to the Bucs for giving me that call.
event_description: Reflecting on the phone call he received from the Buccaneers when they selected him in the fifth round.

statement_made: Tampa feels like a great spot. Ready to get in that wide receiver room and learn from the vets like Mike (Evans).
event_description: Reacting to being drafted in the third round by Tampa Bay after they traded down to pick 84.

statement_made: I was just waiting for my name to be called. Getting that call from Coach Bowles was surreal.
event_description: Commenting on being the fifth-round selection for the Buccaneers.

statement_made: I’m ready to bring that physical presence to the Ravens' line. It’s an honor to play for this organization.
event_description: Discussing his selection by Baltimore in the first round as a solidifying presence for their offensive line.

statement_made: Buffalo is exactly where I wanted to be. I’m ready to contribute to that pass rush and help the Bills win.
event_description: First-round pick for the Bills expressing his excitement about joining the team's defensive unit.

statement_made: I’m here to play physical football. The Bills wanted size on the outside, and that’s what they’re getting.
event_description: Addressing his role as a physical cornerback in Buffalo's secondary after being drafted in the second round.

statement_made: I’m looking forward to learning from the guys in Carolina. I want to be a cornerstone for this offensive line.
event_description: First-round offensive tackle for the Panthers discussing his long-term goals for the franchise.

statement_made: When the work is put in, the decisions speak for themselves. I’m here to lead this defense for a long time.
event_description: Reflecting on his role as the face of the Cowboys' defense during the 2026 offseason.

statement_made: I fit this defense. Chicago wants toughness and versatility in the secondary, and I’m ready to deliver.
event_description: Draft night interview with the Bears' first-round pick regarding his schematic fit.

statement_made: I know there’s a lot of pressure with DJ (Moore) gone. I’m just going to play my game and help us win.
event_description: Responding to questions about taking on a larger role in the Bears' offense following a veteran trade.

statement_made: Grateful for the chance through the International Pathway Program. Ready to show Seattle what I can do.
event_description: Reflecting on his addition to the Seahawks' roster as an international player.
